selection.ownership: Bitrise Ltd, operator of bitrise.io (founded Hungary; international mobile CI/CD). Reviewed edition is the public API at api.bitrise.io, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Bitrise API v0.1 (Authorization personal access token without Bearer prefix, GET /v0.1/me, GET /v0.1/apps, GET /v0.1/apps/{app-slug}/builds, GET /v0.1/apps/{app-slug}/builds/{build-slug}), personal access tokens, SOC 2 Type II (July 2025), and dated incident search for Bitrise security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. Log4j 2021 was patched with no reported customer impact. Status-page outages are availability. No current unresolved Bitrise customer-data compromise is asserted.

Official raw Authorization token to api.bitrise.io/v0.1, GET /me as cheap authenticated profile read, apps and builds list/get, Hungarian/international operator identity, SOC 2 Type II, and dated incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying unresolved customer-data compromise identified.

incidents.affectedData: Vendor reported no successful exploitation and no customer impact through Bitrise code.
incidents.remediation: Bitrise patched the single Log4j instance and found no exploitation in telemetry.
incidents.residualRisk: Third-party/custom workflow steps remain caller-owned. Live authentication unverified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to official GET /v0.1/me from the native validator. Profile fetch is not a named upstream action, so the mapping reuses list_apps.
Authorization sends the raw token without a Bearer prefix, matching official docs and the pinned executor.
Native omits the upstream user-agent. POST trigger_build is omitted as a write.
Optional sortBy, next, limit, title, and projectType map to sort_by, next, limit, title, and project_type. Returns raw Bitrise JSON under data instead of the upstream unwrapped {apps,paging}.
appSlug is URL-encoded in the path. Optional filters map to the documented snake_case query names. Returns raw Bitrise JSON under data.
appSlug and buildSlug are URL-encoded path segments. Returns raw Bitrise JSON under data instead of the upstream unwrapped {build}.
Maps to GET /apps/{app-slug}/secrets. Values are not returned.
EventOnly inbound webhook for build trigger events. No outbound HTTP request.
EventOnly inbound webhook for build finished events. No outbound HTTP request.
